about.title: About the Project
about.text: The Lagovsky Case — an independent information archive. The project's goal is to systematize public documents, court rulings, and media materials to ensure transparency of the legal process.
about.disclaimer: All published documents were obtained from open sources or provided by the defense as part of the right to public advocacy.

copyright.text: © 2025–2026 Lagovsky Case Archive. Information is updated as new court rulings become available.
